verdict.rationale: Motion documents several built-in AI assistants that do work for the user: an AI Meeting Notetaker that follows up with action items, an AI Workflow Builder that builds workflows from SOPs, an AI Search Assistant, and AI scheduling that places tasks on the calendar automatically. These are narrow, feature-specific helpers, not a general assistant you hand arbitrary tasks to, and the evidence is only one-line marketing claims. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks, documentation of how delegation works and its limits, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Takes perfect notes and follows-up with action items for you
Automatically builds workflows based on SOPs
Instantly finds anything - docs, notes, project, task, communication
Quickly create tasks with your voice, and Motion's AI scheduling algorithm will automatically put them on your calendar.
